selectedWork.solution: Editorial Destination Platform + Custom Inquiry Integration

methodology.title: DISCOVER
methodology.description: Understand the true business problem, market context, and operational bottlenecks before prescribing technology.

methodology.title: DIAGNOSE
methodology.description: Isolate root friction—whether in positioning, customer discovery, manual processes, or software architecture.

methodology.title: DESIGN
methodology.description: Craft intentional user experiences, system architectures, and clear brand messaging designed for real human workflows.

methodology.title: BUILD
methodology.description: Engineer resilient web platforms, business systems, or SaaS products using modern, reliable software standards.

methodology.title: DEPLOY
methodology.description: Launch systems safely into operational environments with full team onboarding, zero downtime, and robust performance.

methodology.title: EVOLVE
methodology.description: Iterate continuously based on real-world usage evidence, growth data, and evolving operational demands.

principles.title: Problem before platform.
principles.description: We never push a tech stack or framework before understanding what is actually preventing growth or operational efficiency.

principles.title: Evidence before assumptions.
principles.description: Decisions are rooted in verified user behavior, operational data, and business reality—never speculative trends.

principles.title: Simple before complex.
principles.description: The best digital system is the simplest one that solves the underlying problem cleanly and reliably.

principles.title: Build for reality.
principles.description: Software must perform on actual field devices, unreliable networks, and real workshop floors—not just ideal demos.

principles.title: Launch isn't the finish line.
principles.description: A system's value is proven after deployment. We refine, optimize, and scale based on real-world impact.
